title: The angel slays 185,000 Assyrians
summary: The angel of the Lord slays 185,000 in the Assyrian camp (2 Kgs 19:35).
description: The angel of the Lord slays 185,000 in the Assyrian camp (2 Kgs 19:35). The year is the Appendix F figure, stored as printed.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 2: CFAH Reply to Beckman (Griffith & White, Part 2): 713 BC (early Autumn). Sort changed by the Reply to Beckman pass (2026-11-13): was ussher-jones 709 BC.

chronologies.citation: Griffith & White, "A Reply to Beckman’s Defense of Thiele’s Chronology, Part 2: An Objectivist Answer to the Assyrian Synchronisms," OSF preprint v2.10 (2025), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/DT6GX, Table 3, row 713 comment, pp. 44–45; section “Confirmation from Taharqa and the Tangi-Var Inscription”, p. 24
chronologies.note: Assyrian western army destroyed, 185,000 dead. The Jones Appendix F entry stored here reads 709; see OPEN-QUESTIONS.

chronologies.citation: Jones, The Chronology of the Old Testament: A Return to the Basics, 23rd ed. (Master Books, 2026), Appendix F, printed p. 279 (PDF p. 314)
chronologies.note: Jones's 709 BC line for the 185,000. Distinct from sennacherib-besieges-jerusalem, which carries the 713 BC first invasion, and from sennacherib-second-invasion.
